rubricScores.criterion: Recognized that the 'not defined' (FS0039) errors occur ONLY on the net472 target framework
Identified the undefined symbols as .NET-only runtime hot-reload/loading APIs: MetadataUpdater, AssemblyLoadContext, System.Runtime.Loader
Explained that net472 (.NET Framework 4.7.2) lacks these APIs, hence the FS0039 errors
Recognized FS0072 (type-inference) errors as a cascade downstream of the undefined symbols, not independent bugs
Noted that a small number of net10.0 errors (FS0001 type mismatches) are a separate, real problem

scenarios.scenario: Analysis — Diagnose the root cause of the compiler errors
scenarios.reasoning: The agent performed a solid root cause analysis. It correctly identified the two main categories of errors, explained the net472 API incompatibility as the primary cause, recognized cascade errors, and identified the secondary API signature mismatch issue. The approach was methodical - starting with an overview, then drilling into error codes, checking target frameworks, and verifying which errors appear on which TFM. Minor weaknesses include some imprecision in error counts and not being fully explicit about FS0039 being net472-only (vs also having issues on net10.0). The suggested fixes are appropriate and actionable.
